title.zh-CN: 口渴消瘦后出现呕吐与深大呼吸
title.en: Vomiting and deep breathing after thirst and weight loss

summary.zh-CN: 青年近期明显消瘦，呕吐后出现急促深呼吸及皮下异常触感，需要同时处理代谢与胸部问题。
summary.en: A young adult loses substantial weight, then develops vomiting, deep rapid breathing and abnormal subcutaneous texture.

provenance.citation: 邢西迁, 王晋, 杨志坚, 肖谊, 魏星, 李志东, 吴绪伟. 糖尿病酮症酸中毒并发纵隔气肿一例. 中华结核和呼吸杂志. 2011;34(11):859-860. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1001-0939.2011.11.021.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: 2024 adult hyperglycaemic crises consensus, checked 2026-10-28; scope monitored DKA care and avoidance of routine bicarbonate; no specific air-leak drainage recommendation inferred.

finding.en: Heart rate 120/min and respiratory rate 40/min with deep rapid breathing; crepitus at the neck, anterior chest and abdominal wall with reduced breath sounds.

text.zh-CN: CT显示纵隔和皮下积气，食管扩张，未见明确食管气管撕裂；后续胃镜见咖啡渣样物和十二指肠充血，未发现明显食管胃壁穿孔。
text.en: CT showed mediastinal and subcutaneous air with oesophageal dilatation but no definite oesophageal/tracheal tear; subsequent endoscopy showed coffee-ground material and duodenal congestion without obvious oesophageal/gastric perforation.

text.zh-CN: 原报告补液胰岛素、胃肠减压及颈部引流后改善，一周左右积气基本吸收，后续化验恢复，住院约两周出院，随访两年未复发。
text.en: The report described improvement after fluids, insulin, gastric decompression and cervical drainage; air largely resolved within about a week, laboratory abnormalities recovered, and discharge followed about two weeks with no recurrence over two years.

prompt.zh-CN: 深大呼吸和握雪感应怎样整合？
prompt.en: How should deep breathing and crepitus be integrated?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: DKA同时存在胸部漏气征象，不能将所有呼吸困难归于酸中毒
text.en: DKA coexists with evidence of thoracic air leakage; acidosis cannot explain all respiratory findings

feedback.zh-CN: 皮下握雪感要求独立影像评估。
feedback.en: Subcutaneous crepitus requires separate imaging assessment.

text.zh-CN: DKA能解释握雪感，无需胸部评估
text.en: DKA explains crepitus without chest assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 酸中毒本身不能替代漏气定位。
feedback.en: Acidosis does not replace localisation of air leakage.

text.zh-CN: 有胸部体征就排除代谢危象
text.en: Chest signs exclude a metabolic emergency

feedback.zh-CN: 高糖、酮症和酸中毒均已存在。
feedback.en: Hyperglycaemia, ketosis and acidosis are all present.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 已见纵隔气肿且检查未见明显破裂，但仍需按症状评估危险漏气原因
text.en: Pneumomediastinum is documented without an obvious tear, while dangerous causes still require symptom-based assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性报告降低某些可能，不可宣称任何时点绝对无穿孔。
feedback.en: Negative reports reduce some possibilities without proving absolute absence at every time.

text.zh-CN: 咖啡渣呕吐本身已确证食管破裂
text.en: Coffee-ground emesis alone proves oesophageal rupture

feedback.zh-CN: 它提示出血而非特异穿孔证据。
feedback.en: It indicates bleeding rather than specific proof of perforation.

text.zh-CN: 仅靠此次DKA可确定终身糖尿病分型
text.en: This DKA episode alone determines lifelong diabetes type

feedback.zh-CN: 分型需后续内分泌证据，原文具体数值不全。
feedback.en: Classification requires later endocrine evidence whose detailed values are incomplete.

prompt.zh-CN: 如何安全处理这一组合？
prompt.en: How should this combination be managed safely?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 按成人DKA规范监测补液、胰岛素和电解质，并专科评估漏气严重度与是否需介入
text.en: Use monitored adult DKA care and specialist assessment of air-leak severity and intervention need

feedback.zh-CN: 不能将单例颈部引流或纠酸措施推广为所有病例必需。
feedback.en: One report’s cervical drainage or acid correction cannot become mandatory for every case.

text.zh-CN: 所有DKA纵隔气肿都必须颈部切开
text.en: Every DKA-related pneumomediastinum requires cervical incision

feedback.zh-CN: 侵入处置取决于实际严重度和并发症。
feedback.en: Invasive management depends on actual severity and complications.

text.zh-CN: pH7.10就一律常规大剂量碳酸氢钠
text.en: pH 7.10 mandates routine high-dose bicarbonate

feedback.zh-CN: 2024成人共识不支持常规使用，需明确适应证。
feedback.en: The 2024 adult consensus does not support routine use without an indication.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明呼吸表现同时包含代偿和漏气线索。；承认未提供完整糖尿病分型数值、漏气压力和介入必要性评估。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Respiratory findings include both compensation and air-leak clues.; acknowledge Detailed diabetes-classification values, air-leak pressure and intervention-necessity assessment are unavailable. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告诊断DKA合并自发性纵隔及皮下气肿。
conclusion.en: The source diagnosed DKA with spontaneous pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 呼吸表现同时包含代偿和漏气线索。
keyReasoning.en: Respiratory findings include both compensation and air-leak clues.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性破裂检查应保留边界。
keyReasoning.en: Negative rupture studies require bounded interpretation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 处置强度须由病情而非标题决定。
keyReasoning.en: Management intensity depends on severity rather than a label.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不能因DKA而忽略呕吐后胸部风险。
teachingPoints.en: Do not overlook post-vomiting thoracic risk because DKA is present.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 旧纠酸方案不等于现行推荐。
teachingPoints.en: Historical acid correction is not current routine advice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不从未报告C肽数值补造分型。
teachingPoints.en: Do not invent classification from unreported C-peptide values.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.
